aurinkouuni: A solar oven: an oven that heats up from the sun. It needs no electricity, gas or wood.
grilli: A grill: a device for cooking food outdoors, usually with charcoal or wood.
heijastaa: To reflect: light hits a surface and bounces off in another direction. A mirror reflects light.
asiakas: A customer: a person who buys a product or a service.
suurennuslasi: A magnifying glass: a lens that makes small things look bigger. The sun can heat the spot under it until it is very hot.
hätänumero: The emergency number, 112. You call it when someone is in danger or needs help fast.
tulva: A flood: there is too much water, and it covers the ground or goes into houses.
ensiapu: First aid: the first help for a person who is hurt or sick, before a doctor or an ambulance arrives.
ammattikoulu: Vocational school: a school where you study for a specific job. You learn theory and practical work.
VPK: A volunteer fire brigade. People help with the fire brigade's work, often without pay.
pantti: Deposit: money you pay for a bottle or a can. You get it back when you return the bottle or can to a shop.
panttikuitti: A deposit receipt: a paper that shows how much deposit you have returned. You can use it as money or a discount in the shop.
kesätyöntekijä: A summer worker: a person who works only in the summer.
kierrätys: Recycling: old things are made into new things. This creates less waste.
logistiikka: Logistics: the work of moving and storing products so they are in the right place at the right time.
ainesosa: An ingredient: something that a food is made of. The ingredients are listed on the package.
mekanismi: A mechanism: the parts of a machine that move together and do the work.
pop-up: A pop-up shop: a shop that is open only for a short time, for example one day.
kate: Margin: the money left from the selling price after you subtract what the product cost you. Example: sold for 39 €, bought for 22 € → margin 17 €.
vuokra: Rent: money you pay regularly to use a space or a home that belongs to someone else.
asiakaspalvelu: Customer service: helping customers, answering their questions and solving their problems.
palaute: Feedback: what people tell you about how something went, so you can improve it.
catering: Catering: preparing food and bringing it to a place, for example to a meeting or a party.
pähkinä: A nut. Some people are allergic to nuts and must not eat them. Allergies can be serious, so people ask.
harjoittelu: Internship / work placement: a short period working at a workplace to learn the job.
korkeakoulu: Higher education: a university or a university of applied sciences, where you study for a higher degree.
tutkinto: A degree or qualification: an official certificate that you completed a programme of study.
biodiversiteetti: biodiversity: the variety of living things (plants, animals, fungi) in a place.
edistyä: to make progress: to learn or move forward.
ennakkoluulo: prejudice: an assumption about a person without knowing them.
hakea: to apply: to ask for a place (for example in a study programme).
kahdenkeskinen: one-to-one: only two people take part.
kestävä kehitys: sustainable development: living and working so that nature and people stay well in the future too.
kokoonpano: line-up: the players who play in a game.
kuntoutus: rehabilitation: treatment and exercise to recover after an injury.
lähtötaso: starting level: what you can do at the beginning.
meno: expense: something money is spent on.
opinnot: studies: going to school or a programme.
painostaa: to pressure: to try to make someone do something against their will.
pettymys: disappointment: a bad feeling when a hope does not come true.
selvittää: to find out: to get information about something.
toive: wish: something you would like to happen.
tutustuminen: getting to know: trying something new and learning about it.
vastuu: responsibility: something you take care of.
väyläopinnot: pathway studies: studies that lead on to further studies, for example at a university of applied sciences.
